description: BEVL-01 SC #2: a business with no failing gate assesses as HEALTHY — cited findings present and ZERO gaps. gapCount 0 paired with findingsPresent is what separates this from the honest not-enough-data verdict
turns: Health check on my business, Harborline Studio. What we sell is a done-for-you brand sprint, and lifetime gross profit per client (LTGP) is about 2400 dollars.

Two more things about how we sell: the brand sprint is our attraction offer, the front door people buy first, and we also run a monthly retainer plan that clients stay on — that's our continuity offer.
On acquisition: warm outreach is the one channel we actually run, every single week, and it keeps us full.
That's everything. Now evaluate my business.
